wish: someone should make an app that makes computer bleeping noises when you do things
spec:
Plays short synthesized retro bleeps on every tap, key press and toggle.
Tap the pads, type in the field or flip the checkbox; pick one of four sound sets and set the volume.
It only reacts inside its own page and does not play sound for other apps.
notes: Works only within this page; browsers do not allow a web page to make sound on actions in other apps.
